Question: Assalam i've some prob in my life first i'm not getting a job tell me some ayats so dat i can recite it in favour of god n pray for getting it. (Fatwa: 1828/1556=B/1429) Recite the below duas excessively: لَا اِلَہَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَکَ اِنِّیْ کُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِیْنَ لا حول ولا قوة إلا باللہ العلي العظیم Your problems shall be solved and you shall get job, in-sha-Allah!
